resumeText:
Ishita Banerjee | Kolkata, West Bengal | ishita.banerjee.grc@example.com

EDUCATION
B.Tech, Information Technology, Salt Lake Institute of Technology, Kolkata (2022 - 2026) | CGPA 8.5/10

INTERNSHIP
GRC Intern, Hooghly Risk Advisors, Kolkata (Jun 2025 - Aug 2025, 10 weeks)
- Mapped 40 ISO 27001 Annex A controls to evidence shared by a mid-size software client.
- Drafted an acceptable use policy and a password policy for the client from the firm's templates.
- Collected screenshots and logs as audit evidence for the internal audit of the client's HR systems.

PROJECTS
- Department lab risk register (academic, Information Security course): Prepared a risk register for the college computer lab with likelihood and impact scores for 18 risks.
- Phishing awareness survey: Surveyed 150 students on phishing habits and wrote a short report with recommendations.

COURSEWORK AND CERTIFICATIONS
- ISO/IEC 27001 Foundation (online, 2025)
- Coursework: Information Security, Computer Networks, Cyber Law, Software Engineering

SKILLS
ISO 27001, Risk assessment, Policy writing, Identity and access management basics, MS Excel, PowerPoint

ACTIVITIES
- Presented the risk register findings to the head of department and lab staff
- Secretary, college debating society
